notes.title: End of Open Alpha & Demo Announcement
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43704778/a73fe837615cc3301e17f648e7a06eadf60e42d2.png[/img]

Hello, operators!

The Zero Division open alpha playtest has been running for three weeks now, and we've gathered a ton of bug reports and suggestions for fixing and improving the game. We're super grateful to all our playtesters for their time in giving the alpha build a try, and their incredibly helpful feedback.

As such, whilst we're ending the alpha playtest shortly, we're pleased to announce that a full demo version will be launched in the next few weeks!

The new demo will include a number of new features and fixes, including:
[list]
[*] [b]Draft Mode Demo[/b] - A demo version of draft mode, where players will draft their crew, augments, and cards, and take their builds through a gauntlet of bosses. Whilst the full game will contain randomized bosses, the demo version includes two encounters - the fearsome Vindicator Gunship, and the Abomination's angrier cousin - the Aberration.
[*] [b]Failsafe Overhaul[/b] - A fixed and overhauled Failsafe system, which aims to fix the intermittent bugs with imprinting and which will limit the number of cards that can be imprinted at any one time. This is to ensure that opening shards and drafting cards in Campaign Mode will remain relevant in repeated playthroughs, whilst retaining the edge that the Failsafe metaprogession system adds to future runs.
[*] [b]Mirage Rework[/b] - A rework for Mirage's signature cards, which have largely been buffed to bring her in line with the other operators.
[*] [b]Balance Pass[/b] - A first [b]balance pass[/b] for a number of cards to bring up the weaker / less used cards in the set, and to slightly decrease the powerof a small handful of more powerful cards.
[/list]We look forward to seeing you again in Zerzura!

- Robot Cat

notes.title: Patch 0.592 - Zero Division Open Alpha
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43704778/5e46c73f5f812d8974ae845177e7214526b60ae7.png[/img]

Hello, operators!

We're pleased to release [b]Patch 0.592[/b], which contains the second batch of changes in response to player feedback, along with a small new feature - Perfect Victories!

This patch aims to address an intermittent issue which causes the game to soft-lock - we think we've identified the root of the problem, but if you do encounter freezes in this version, please let us know via the Feedback button or by posting in the Steam Community Hub.

Thank you for testing, and we hope to see you in Zerzura!

- Robot Cat

[b]Patch Notes - 0.592[/b]

[b]New Feature - Perfect Victory[/b]
[list]
[*] Veteran operators will know that whilst encounters with enemies may seem daunting at first, clever use of your resources can often lead to flawless victories. In Patch 0.592, defeating a combat encounter without taking unblocked damage will result in a Perfect Victory, with a slightly different end screen and increased Gleam rewards!
[/list]
[b]Stability[/b]
[list]
[*] In previous versions, the game would occasionally soft-lock during combat, and the changes in the last patch exacerbated this issue. This Patch 0.592 overhauls some of the architecture which may lead to these soft-locks, which we hope will fix this issue.
[/list]
[b]UI/UX[/b]
[list]
[*] In response to feedback, a large portrait has been added to the smaller portraits on the lower left of the UI which indicates the current active operator.
[*] The Failsafe panel now shows cards in your decks as well as those in your collection.
[*] An indicator has been added to the Vault panel button to show when you have unopened Data Shards.
[*] The tooltip when hovering over your currencies in the hub has been increased in size.
[*] FX have been added when Jinn's Autocannon passive ability triggers and when the Retaliate effect triggers to make it clear that these effects are working.
[/list]
[b]Balance[/b]
[list]
[*] The Protection effect now stacks, and so can absorb multiple damage sources (but all stacks are still removed at start of round).
[/list]
[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where opening and closing the Settings menu whilst on the end of combat reward screen is displaying allows interaction with the underlying board.
[*] The stacks on certain mods were not counting down when removed. This has been fixed.
[*] The Motherdroid ability previously had no keyword tooltip. This has been fixed.
[*] Zen Focus has been changed so that it no longer grants negative attack if you have a hand with more than 6 cards.
[*] Fixed the effects of Ignore Pain, Brainstorm, and Decoy Grenade.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 0.591 - Zero Division Open Alpha
notes.content:
Hello, operators!

The Zero Division Open Alpha has been running for a few days now, and the feedback we've received from our playtesters has been fantastic in helping us steer our efforts in improving players' experience. We've read and considered every word, and we're pleased to present the first batch of changes in this [b]Patch 0.591[/b].

Below, you'll find a list of some of the most common issues, and how Patch 0.591 aims to address them. Additional changes - which require more work and which we haven't yet had time to implement - will follow in later patches, including changes to the Failsafe system and additional UI refinements.

[b]Patch Notes - 0.591[/b]

[b]Key Changes[/b]
[list]
[*] [i]Feedback: The text size is too small / I can't see what's happening / This game is made for ants[/i]

Most of the UI text and card text have been increased in size. Tooltips on mods and augments have been reworked to be larger.

[*][i]Feedback: The attack animation takes too long / Playing cards takes too long[/i]

We've made some refinements to make playing cards faster. In addition, a slider has been added on top of the "End Round" button which allows players to skip the attack animation, allowing for much faster attacks. This setting is on by default. Please note that this is experimental, and may result in a few bugs.

[*][i]Feedback: The dialogue moves too fast / The dialogue can't be skipped[/i]

All of the dialogue now persists for longer to give players an opportunity to read the text. All individual pieces of dialogue, including in the tutorial, can now be skipped by pressing spacebar. In addition, an entire conversation can be skipped by clicking the cross on the top right corner of the dialogue box.

[*][i]Feedback: Please add an easier way to switch between operators' hands (other than clicking the portraits in the bottom left corner)[/i]

You can now switch between operators' hands by right-clicking the operator's unit on the game board.
[/list]
[b]UI/UX[/b]
[list]
[*] Cards and mods which refer to card types (Tactic, Gear, Shot, and Strike) will now display the icon of the relevant type next to the text. This was previously inconsistently displayed only in certain cards and mods.
[*] Cooldown icons have been added to activated abilities for improved readability.
[*] The "live" area in the Vault where data shards could be dragged was smaller than intended. This has been fixed.
[/list]
[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] A critical bug causing soft-locks when playing the Oilpetal Venom card has been fixed.
[*] Brainstorm was working incorrectly, and could be played even if the owner was Exhausted. The effect has been changed to target an unexhausted ally (which may be the card owner), and now draws 2 cards instead of 3.
[/list]
A huge thanks to the playtesters for providing your feedback. It's much appreciated, and we hope you will continue to help us improve!

- Robot Cat
